channel.title: Pier & Point · 700 Indiana St
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 700 Indiana St (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · 700 Indiana St: New nearby-project record for 700 Indiana St, a proposed lab/office building for MBC BioLabs next to Pier 70, approved by the Planning Commission in June 2024; the Board of Supervisors rejected a neighborhood CEQA appeal in September 2024.
item.description: New nearby-project record for 700 Indiana St, a proposed lab/office building for MBC BioLabs next to Pier 70, approved by the Planning Commission in June 2024; the Board of Supervisors rejected a neighborhood CEQA appeal in September 2024. Source: California CEQAnet, 700 Indiana Street Project, Notice of Exemption (https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2025010779); Citizen Portal, 2024-09-24 (https://citizenportal.ai/articles/6596036/california/san-francisco-county/board-upholds-planning-departments-general-plan-evaluation-for-proposed-dogpatch-biotech-lab-after-heated-ceqa-appeal); San Francisco YIMBY, 2025-02-02 (https://sfyimby.com/2025/02/environmental-streamlining-for-700-indiana-street-in-dogpatch-san-francisco.html).

item.title: Milestone · 700 Indiana St: SF Board of Supervisors votes 9-1 to uphold the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption, rejecting a neighborhood appeal (Appeal No. 24-040); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote. (Sep 24, 2024)
item.description: SF Board of Supervisors votes 9-1 to uphold the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption, rejecting a neighborhood appeal (Appeal No. 24-040); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote. (Sep 24, 2024). Source: City and County of San Francisco, via California CEQAnet Web Portal; Citizen Portal, 2024-09-24.
